name: Quill
source:
MBTI: INTJ

"...I'm fine. Thank you. Come on, we should try to figure out what's going on here as quickly as possible."

The junior lawyer with an outstanding sense of reasoning and composure. Seeking to both bring forth the truth and sustain cooperation, Quill values order above all else. Left only with the vague memories of what might've been a broken home, Quill's priority is being able to coordinate and ensure the safety of his fellow captives.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
